subject: EdgeAnalytics trial — invoice routing and temporary PO coverage
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@edgeanalytics.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Trial onboarding and procurement question

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the EdgeAnalytics team is excited to run a short pilot of the Redwood hosted inference for our anomaly detection models. Procurement asked for guidance before we start: they typically need a purchase order before any vendor invoices, but for short trials that run 30–60 days they prefer to issue invoices without a PO.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood accept invoices for the pilot without a formal PO while we finalize contract terms?
- If not, what is the fastest path to a one-time waiver or temporary coverage so we can kick off immediately?

Attached are the pilot requirements and expected usage (EA_trial_requirements.pdf).

Appreciate any friction-minimizing options — our CISO also wants to make sure we have a signed addendum if you require it.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Product Operations
EdgeAnalytics, Inc.
[attachment: EA_trial_requirements.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@edgeanalytics.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding and procurement question

Hi Samantha — welcome and thanks for the clear summary + attachment. Looping in Monica (CS lead) and Aditya (sales) — and Rishi from finance for approval.

Short answer: we can often start pilots without a PO if the total expected spend for the pilot is below our finance threshold and a one-time waiver is approved. To move quickly, please confirm:
- Estimated pilot spend (approx. USD for the 60-day window)
- Whether EdgeAnalytics can sign a short trial addendum (we can send a one-page DocuSign)

Internal note for the group: Monica/Aditya — can we get an estimate and propose a waiver limit? Rishi — would finance consider a temporary coverage up to $7.5k with addendum + invoice to AP@redwood.com? I can route the signed addendum and waiver doc once we have agreement.

Thanks — I want to avoid procurement delays if possible.

Irene
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@edgeanalytics.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding and procurement question

Thanks — quick update from CS + sales on expected consumption: based on the test profile in EA_trial_requirements.pdf, we estimate total spend around $4,200 over 45 days (mainly hosted API calls).

Proposal to unblock:
- Redwood issues a one-time waiver to allow EdgeAnalytics to be invoiced without a PO for the pilot (cap $5k).
- EdgeAnalytics signs a short trial addendum clarifying data handling and termination for the pilot.
- Edge sends invoices to AP@redwood.com with a note referencing the waiver number.

Samantha — if you confirm the estimate and can sign the addendum, I’ll kick off the waiver request form and attach the internal procurement record.

On a separate note, procurement sometimes requests our vendor onboarding form completed for trials; I’m attaching a short checklist.

Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: EA_trial_requirements.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@edgeanalytics.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding and procurement question

Irene/Monica — finance reviewed the ask. We can approve a one-time procurement waiver for up to $7,500 for trials provided two conditions are met:
1) EdgeAnalytics signs the Redwood trial addendum (DocuSign)
2) Invoices are addressed to AP@redwood.com and reference waiver ID PROC-2026-0479

I’m attaching the completed waiver form (one-time-waiver-form.pdf) — I’ll countersign once Samantha returns the signed addendum.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance
Redwood Inference
[attachment: one-time-waiver-form.pdf]

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@edgeanalytics.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding and procurement question

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed internally and confirm the pilot spend estimate (~$4.2k). We have signed the trial addendum and attached it here.

Next steps from EdgeAnalytics:
- We will send the first invoice to AP@redwood.com and reference PROC-2026-0479 on the invoice.
- Please confirm the waiver is active and that Redwood will accept the invoice without a PO for this pilot.

Attached: EA_Redwood_trial_addendum_signed.pdf

Best,
Samantha
[attachment: EA_Redwood_trial_addendum_signed.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@edgeanalytics.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding and procurement question

Samantha — received, thank you and welcome aboard.

Rishi — can you confirm on thread that the waiver is executed and that AP will process the invoice net30? If yes, Monica/Aditya will proceed with provisioning and we’ll mark PROC-2026-0479 as the procurement record.

Samantha — next steps we’ll take here:
- Rishi to countersign waiver and confirm AP routing/compliance (expected within business day)
- Monica to provision trial environment and share onboarding checklist + success metrics doc
- Aditya to log the deal and update the CRM (Deal ID EDGE-TRIAL-202609)

I’m marking this thread as the canonical record for the temporary coverage.

Thanks everyone — let’s aim to have the pilot live by next Tuesday.

Irene
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
